F3_permutation_null.reading: the real F1 solution must be CHEAPER than this null distribution; if it sits inside it, the cost floor is a property of the arm-cost spread, not of which arm is accurate on which cell

Q2b_open_arm_flop_efficiency.title: how much accuracy does each open-text FLOP-eq buy, measured from the SAME 7B-greedy start
Q2b_open_arm_flop_efficiency.convention: macro over the 3 open cells (equal weight), as-charged R32=4.57
Q2b_open_arm_flop_efficiency.verdict: on open text one 32B-direct forward buys 10.06x more macro accuracy per FLOP-eq than the whole 7B best-of-N + verifier machinery (0.02514 vs 0.00250 points per extra FLOP-eq).  The 7B side of the open arm alone costs 2.41x one always-32B-direct pass and still lands 0.0647 BELOW it in macro-open accuracy.

F2b_the_wall.title: the compute wall: the cheapest cost at which the pre-registered non-inferiority constraint can be met AT ALL, with full eval visibility
F2b_the_wall.statement: with FULL EVAL VISIBILITY and a free per-cell choice over all 6 deployable arms, no assignment cheaper than 0.8619x always-32B-direct (as-charged) / 0.8727x (derived R32) can satisfy CI-lower-bound >= -0.0029.  The best achievable macro accuracy at the next cheaper envelope point (0.8408x) is 0.6557, delta -0.0010 with lo -0.0032 -- it FAILS.  The compute floor at non-inferiority is therefore ~0.86x, i.e. at most ~14% cheaper than the baseline, and that is an UNREACHABLE bound, not a result.

only_32B_free_point.note: always-7B on all 8 cells -- the ONLY envelope point that never loads the 32B
